Title: Two emergencies flagged within the same second are called in token order, not flagging order
Steps to reproduce: 1. Issue 3 walk-ins. 2. Flag token 3 as emergency. 3. Immediately flag token 2.

Title: Valid Hindi/Marathi names are rejected
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open /book. 2. Enter name रवि कुमार and a valid phone. 3. Submit.
Actual: 'Enter the full name using letters only' (vowel signs were not allowed)
Fixed in: Name check now accepts letters and combining marks

Title: No limit on failed staff login attempts
Steps to reproduce: Try many wrong passwords in a row

Title: Anyone who knows a phone number can open that patient's token status
Steps to reproduce: Use 'Track My Token' with someone else's number
Actual: Status page opens directly (first name and token shown only)

Title: Online token can be booked with another person's phone number
Steps to reproduce: Book with a phone number you do not own

Title: Self check-in ('I'm here') can be pressed from home (no location check)
Steps to reproduce: 1. Book a token. 2. When check-in opens, tap I'm here while not at the clinic.
Expected: Check-in only when physically at the clinic
Actual: Check-in allowed from anywhere once the window opens
